subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: The new teacher entered the classroom and said. "Can you tell me what I should do now?" "No, sir," one of the students said. The teacher smiled and said. "Try to guess." "You should introduce yourself to us," another student said. "Thank you," said the teacher, "You are really brilliant."
guide_solution: The new teacher entered the classroom and asked the students if they could tell him what he should do then. One of the students respectfully replied in the negative. At this, the teacher smiled and told them to try to guess. Then another student said that he (t) should introduce himself to them. Then the teacher thanked him and said that he was really brilliant.
